# A CAD book that buys 1,000.00 USD at 1.30, and nothing else.
#
# Nothing but the currency's own movement is in it: no borrowing, no interest,
# no shares. The book the Q-042 tests are drawn from has all three on one US
# dollar account, so a figure computed for that account there cannot be read as
# the currency's alone.
#
# `the_thousand_usd_sold_at_a_higher_rate.txt` sells every dollar of it.
#
# The split that buys them states its own guid, `0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b1000`,
# so a file layered on this book can say a disposal came out of that cost basis
# without being handed the guid at run time.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening CAD
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-02-01 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "13/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-12-31 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "29/20"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

2026-01-15 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 5000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening CAD -5000.00 CAD

2026-02-01 * "Buy 1,000.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 1000.00 USD
		guid: "0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b1000"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "1300.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1300.00 CAD
